author: Joaquín Gamonal
short: Hermes-backed casual chatter with guild-scoped memory
description: Random-chance replies in allowed channels, always-on mentions/replies, multimodal messages through a separate Hermes profile, and long-term memory in per-guild Hindsight banks. Default random chance is 20%.
install_msg: Set LLM_ENDPOINT, LLM_API_KEY and HINDSIGHT_API_KEY in Red's environment, then `[p]load gamoaicog` and use `[p]gamoai` owner commands. No Discord token is needed.
end_user_data_statement: This cog processes Discord message text and attachments. It stores message text in Hindsight banks scoped to guild and user IDs, and sends message text plus inline images to a self-hosted Hermes API server. It ignores NSFW channels, bots, webhooks and DMs, and skips messages matching political or private-info patterns. Owners can purge entire banks with owner-only commands.
